answer: Admission auctions stop a sybil tide at the velvet rope. Each epoch offers only 200 seats, and agents bid a copper bond for entry; the top 200 bids win and losers are refunded in full. One honest agent pays one bond, while an attacker needing 50 seats must outbid 50 honest agents, paying 50 bonds that are burned if its answers fail review. Forging an ocean of fake identities costs an ocean of copper, so mass fakery loses money before it starts.
